text: DBIM MODES PAINT ONLY DBIM'S PUBLISHED SHADES. DBIM publishes five shades per group (rungs 100/200/400/600/800) and three greys plus Linen; the rungs between were this estate's interpolation, and 43 tokens per DBIM mode read them — button fills and focus rings on 500, 'bolder' brand text and link hover on 700, placeholders and chart axes on the #777777 grey (4.48:1, below AA). In every DBIM mode an interpolated rung now resolves to the nearest published shade, the darker on a tie: buttons are shade 2 with shade 1 on hover, brand text and link hover shade 1, the focus ring shade 2, the quiet grey DBIM's Grey 3 #606060 (≈6.3:1). DBIM 3.0 §2.1, §4.4 and §3.7.iii. Green is the one exception: its shade 2 cannot carry white, so its button is shade 1 and its hover rung 900. Blue and navy are untouched — the visual contract moved in the six DBIM selectors only. The primitive ramps are unchanged, so the colour page still shows the full ladder.
